title: Laboratory Serum — 60s Continuous

format.deliveryResolutionNote: Reference-to-video native output is 1280x720; 1920x1080 delivery is an upscale and must be reviewed as such.

creativeBrief: An adult fictional athletic subject undergoes a clearly triggered laboratory transformation into an extreme, balanced hyper-muscular form. The transformation remains continuous for the full 60-second take; camera, wardrobe, room response and sound all track the same event. Intimate anatomy remains non-explicit and covered.

character_policy.adult_status_source: Production brief specifies an adult fictional subject.
character_policy.real_person_reference_permissions: Use only fictional character designs or verified references with appropriate permission.

pipeline.final_visual_generation_mode: xAI Grok Imagine Video 1.5 reference-to-video; four contiguous 15-second segments

timelineSemantics: Four contiguous 15-second provider segments form one 60-second deformation event. Each continuation segment pins its first frame to the previous segment's extracted final frame; pixel-frame hashes must match at all three boundaries. No visible hard cuts.

continuityLocks.face: Preserve adult fictional identity across all frames.
continuityLocks.pectoralBalance: Left/right growth remains balanced in width, projection and thickness.
continuityLocks.anatomy: Continuous transitions across shoulder, chest, arm, back and torso.
continuityLocks.scale: Body mass, height and limb proportions develop coherently.
continuityLocks.wardrobe: Separate cloth simulation or deformation layer; maintain non-explicit coverage.
continuityLocks.terminal: Hold the new baseline through the final frame.

sound.mix: Preserve laboratory room tone; synchronize material and environmental cues to visible deformation.

notes: The project now has an implemented, offline-tested xAI Grok Imagine Video adapter with a cost estimate and explicit safeguards. The 60-second reference-to-video plan is four contiguous 15-second 1280x720 segments; continuation segments pin their first frame to the previous segment's final frame and verify pixel hashes. A 1920x1080 delivery is an upscale, not native 1080p. No XAI_API_KEY is configured, no reference images have been transferred to xAI, and no generation has been submitted. Paid generation remains disabled pending explicit cost approval (current estimate USD 8.40), reference-image transfer approval, and rights clearance. The selected image-library binaries have not yet been staged into 01_SOURCE/REFERENCE_IMAGES, and the canonical Dropbox project folder has not been provisioned. The Blender character preview remains a rejected geometry proxy, not final character imagery. No provider-generated footage, final audio mix, completed master, or Dropbox delivery is claimed.

generation.policy: Do not launch paid generation without explicit user approval. Never substitute a still-image slideshow, procedural placeholder, or fabricated provider result for generated video.
